name: Please Be Solved Vancouver 2020

venue.name: [Irving K Barber Learning Centre](https://learningspaces.ubc.ca/buildings/irving-k-barber-learning-centre-iblc)
venue.address: Irving K Barber Learning Centre, 1961 E Mall, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1
venue.details: The competition will be held at UBC, on the second floor of IBLC in room 261.

information:
This competition has **only blindfolded** and **fewest moves** events. Spectators and competitors must **remain silent** whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration.
While you only need to show up for events/rounds that you are competing in, we would appreciate competitors being present for other events/rounds too when not inconvenient, to **help with judging**. If you have a parent or friend who can come judge, that would be great - it's not hard, even if you know nothing about cubing.

**Note about venue**: Unlike previous competitions held in UBC, this competition's venue is **not** at the Nest. The venue is located in IKB Learning Centre (see Venue Details), which is still quite close to the Nest.
